picks.why: Powell makes switchgear and power-control gear for utilities and data centres, a direct play on the grid bottleneck, with a 21% operating margin and a 3% FCF yield. It is 52% off its high at 22.5x forward earnings, which limits downside compared with the sector.
picks.risk: Revenue growth is only 9% and just 4 analysts cover it, so the grid thesis may not show up in its orders.

picks.why: Celestica beat revenue and EPS, grew revenue 62% and pointed to 2028 demand, yet trades at 11.1x forward earnings, 48% off its high. A 10% operating margin and positive FCF suit the selection filter better than the neocloud names.
picks.risk: Thin margins and customer concentration in hyperscalers mean a capex cut would hit it hard, as the 17.9% five-day drop shows.

passed_on.reason: Neocloud credit stress and 83x forward P/E.
Networking fell 12.5% in five days and the price has no cushion at this stage.
Memory is already covered by three watchlist names and Seagate prints today.
Crowded cyclical equipment, -12.8% over five days.
27x forward P/E leaves little margin of safety.
Foundry equipment is neutral and weak; second-tier choice.
